name: DeviceRegistryEvents
description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint registry creation and modification events

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the registry event occurred

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.description: Fully qualified domain name or hostname of the device

columns.name: RegistryKey
columns.description: Full path of the affected registry key

columns.name: RegistryValueName
columns.description: Name of the modified or created registry value

columns.name: RegistryValueData
columns.description: Data payload assigned to the registry value

columns.name: InitiatingProcessCommandLine
columns.description: Command line of the modifying process

columns.name: InitiatingProcessAccountName
columns.description: User account that modified the registry
